title: Quercetin Dosage: A Guide to Safe Limits & Side Effects
abstract: One compound gaining attention is quercetin, often paired in supplements like quercetin with bromelain to enhance its effects. At standard doses (500–1000 mg/day), quercetin is very well tolerated. * The tolerable upper dose studied in clinical trials is 1000 mg/day for up to 12 weeks. * Very high doses (above 1000 mg/day long-term) have shown nephrotoxicity signals in animal studies — not yet confirmed in humans at standard supplement doses. When paired with plant pigments in *supplement* form, this enzyme acts like a master key—unlocking your body’s ability to utilize beneficial compounds more effectively. ## Potential Health Benefits of Quercetin and Bromelain Supplementation. When incorporating any new supplement into your routine, understanding proper dosing is crucial for both safety and effectiveness. At standard supplement doses (500–1000 mg/day), kidney toxicity has not been observed in human studies. Always inform your doctor about quercetin supplementation if you take prescription medications. Quercetin & Bromelain at the clinically studied 1000 mg dose — effective, safe, and well-tolerated for daily immune support.
